/01

CS 499 Capstone · Collaborative productivity

MultiTasked

Source on GitHub

A shared place to keep the work moving.

A collaborative Android task manager for shared projects and everyday life — boards people can create, share, and join, with real-time sync and a grocery mode that totals a list.

  • Jetpack Compose UI with Kotlin Coroutines and Firebase real-time synchronization.
  • Hash-generated list-sharing IDs and Android deep links that route users to the right destination across lifecycle states.
  • MVVM with immutable UI state, typed actions, input validation, reusable composables, and testable dependencies.
  • Custom merge sort and a heap-based priority queue for due-date and urgency sorting, run on background coroutines.
  • A separate offline Room/SQLite workspace with relational data, indexed queries, transactional updates, and migrations.
  • Design, algorithm, and database enhancements documented in a public ePortfolio with code review and automated test evidence.
KotlinJetpack ComposeCoroutinesFirebaseRoomSQLiteMVVM
